title: About
text:
Each week this blog asks a single question about the current NBA season and tries to answer it carefully.
Every post follows the same workflow:

State the question and the quantity (the estimand) that would answer it.
Draw the scientific model: what causes what.
Simulate data from that model before touching real data.
Check the priors by simulating from them.
Fit the model to simulated data and confirm it recovers what we put in.
Fit the real data, check the computation, and check the fit against the data.
Answer the question with honest uncertainty, and say what could be wrong.

The approach follows Richard McElreath’s Statistical Rethinking and Gelman, Vehtari and McElreath’s Bayesian Workflow.
Every post is reproducible: the data it used is frozen as a dated snapshot in the post’s folder, and the code, models and package versions are all in the GitHub repository.
